subject: A review note covers pinned workflows and Dependabot.
source: Reviewed .github/workflows/ci.yml: checkout is pinned to 3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 (v7.0.1) and setup-python to 5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 (v7.0.0). Both SHAs match git ls-remote for those tags. Workflow permissions are contents read, checkout sets persist-credentials false, the test job times out after 15 minutes, and concurrency cancels an older run of the same pull request. The existing steps remain: ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy, pip-audit, and pytest. pytest now passes --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing, and fail_under 85 is in pyproject.toml after a measured branch total of 85.44%. Reviewed .github/workflows/codeql.yml: languages python and actions, build-mode none, codeql-action init and analyze pinned to 2892aa5e19bbd11bc0cff5427e3b750a04d9e3c2 (v4.38.2, the commit of the latest v4 tag). Job permissions are security-events write, contents read, and actions read. Reviewed .github/dependabot.yml: pip at / and github-actions, weekly at 09:00 America/Sao_Paulo, minor and patch grouped into one pull request per ecosystem, open pull request limit 5, commit prefixes chore(deps) and ci(deps). keep-alive.yml already has contents read and no third-party action. retornatus.yml already pins checkout by SHA, sets persist-credentials false, and leaves luizssantiago92/retornatus@v1 on the owner tag. actionlint passed. No application code and no requirements.txt changed.
